index_basis: Zero-based indices from the 53-segment native-spec.draft.json read for this material-only plan; match by narration anchor if later assembly changes indices.

format.note: Sources are 1080 high. Crop is not upscaled in JPEG; displaying at 1080×1440 uses 1.333× enlargement. No claim of 4K photographs.

assembly_guidance: Replace repeated generic venue pictures and selected narration cards with these same-event player portraits. Preserve concise factual labels where stage identity matters.

Suggested primary targets: 9→2005 focus, 14→2005 winner, 23→2012 Djokovic winner, 25→2012 Murray aftermath, 26→2014 second-round winner, 43→2024 Sinner winner, 47→2025 Vacherot winner, 51→2025 awards portrait.
The 2014 portrait is from Federer vs Mayer in the second round, not Federer vs Simon in the final.
The 2025 awards portrait is not the on-court embrace. Keep actual embrace footage for the explicit embrace claim.
Portrait stills remain photos. Do not report the added material as a higher dynamic-video proportion or as complete-point coverage.
Existing 2017 trophy photo is a truthful same-year winner image and need not be duplicated with another still.

segment_narration_anchors: 这一年的决赛，纳尔班迪安原本只是替补入围。
photos.caption: 纳尔班迪安在2005大师杯决赛中的专注表情；非替补获邀现场。
photos.editorial_safety: Same-final neutral portrait before the comeback account; the capture is late in the match, not the moment he was invited.

segment_narration_anchors: 四小时三十三分钟后，他赢下决胜盘抢七。一个临时得到的参赛机会，成了上海至今难忘的一场决赛。
photos.caption: 纳尔班迪安夺得2005大师杯冠军后的笑容。
photos.editorial_safety: Post-title winner portrait; use after the final result, not as the match-winning point.

segment_narration_anchors: 上海留下的，不只是一个冠军名字。还有那些明明快到终点，却仍然继续的回合。
photos.caption: 2012上海决赛赛后穆雷近景，德约科维奇位于身后。
photos.editorial_safety: Post-match portrait; place after the result. Do not present as Murray taking the lead or losing a championship point.

segment_narration_anchors: 第二盘抢七，德约以十三比十一拿下。到了决胜盘，他两次破发，终于把这场决赛赢了下来。
上海留下的，不只是一个冠军名字。还有那些明明快到终点，却仍然继续的回合。
photos.caption: 2012上海决赛夺冠后的德约科维奇，双拳举起。
photos.editorial_safety: Actual title celebration after the final set, not the earlier tweener reaction or a saved championship point.

segment_narration_anchors: 两年后，费德勒的上海大师赛首冠，也从一次险境开始。
photos.suggested_small_label: 2014第二轮 · 费德勒对梅耶尔
photos.caption: 2014上海大师赛第二轮，费德勒救下五个赛点战胜梅耶尔后的笑容。
photos.editorial_safety: 2014 second round / Federer first match after a first-round bye. Must retain that label; do not present as the final against Gilles Simon or trophy presentation.

segment_narration_anchors: 同一座球场，开始写下新的冠军名字。
photos.caption: 2024上海决赛战胜德约科维奇后，辛纳的近景反应。
photos.editorial_safety: Actual post-title portrait, suitable after the result/new champion line; do not label as the service point itself.

segment_narration_anchors: 先输一盘，再连赢两盘。瓦舍罗成为大师一千赛史上，排名最低的冠军。
photos.caption: 2025上海决赛夺冠后的瓦舍罗，抬头微笑并举起双臂。
photos.editorial_safety: Actual post-title reaction. Do not present as qualification, a ranking announcement or the final point itself.

segment_narration_anchors: 还有逆转、重逢，以及一个新名字被记住的瞬间。
两个亲人争过同一座奖杯，又在赛后相拥。上海，也留下了属于他们的这一页。
photos.caption: 2025上海大师赛决赛颁奖合影：林德克内希左，瓦舍罗右，冠军奖杯在瓦舍罗手中。
photos.editorial_safety: Later posed awards portrait, not their on-court embrace. Best used in the closing montage; if used for the family line, display awards label and retain the real embrace video nearby.

gap_note: No modern venue photo relabeled as an earlier event; no unverified archival photo was added for these years.
